name: Gemini 4 Argon Cyber Permissive
license: Proprietary (Fairwind Program allowlist; Google Frontier Cyber Model terms)
archDisplay: Gemini 4 Argon specialised for defensive cybersecurity (gemini-4-argon-cyber-permissive), served behind a separate allowlist; architecture undisclosed
note: Google's Gemini 4 Argon Cyber Permissive (model id gemini-4-argon-cyber-permissive), a version of Gemini 4 Argon for defensive cybersecurity work (vulnerability discovery, reverse engineering, exploit verification, patch generation). Google's model-versions page gives a release date of October 13, 2026. It is generally available on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform but only behind the Fairwind Program allowlist, so it is filed with apiAvailable false and no headline price, following GPT-6 Cyber, Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber and Gemini 4 Neon for cyber. Same 1,048,576-token context as Gemini 4 Argon; default thinking level HIGH (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH supported), no computer use, regions global, us and eu. Google's Model Garden pricing lists it at $4 input / $20 output per Mtok on the global endpoint ($4.40 / $22 non-global), the post-December-1 Gemini 4 Argon rate, with no promotional pricing. Google published no benchmark figures for it, so it is spec-only. Predecessor is null: it is a variant of Gemini 4 Argon, not its successor.
